meta.name: frame-macos-notification
meta.description: 拟真 macOS 通知 banner + app icon + 标题正文, 适合 video overlay / 产品发布预告

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成拟真 macOS 通知横幅，用于视频叠加或产品预告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频或演示中模拟 macOS 系统通知效果
copy.tagline_en: Generate realistic macOS notification banners for video overlays or product teasers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to simulate macOS notification banners in videos or demos

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的公告或消息渲染成 macOS Big Sur 风格的通知横幅:圆角磨砂玻璃背景、App 图标、标题和正文,输出单文件 HTML,可叠加在 1920×1080 视频角落,也可单独输出 480×120 横幅。
howto.when: 当你要把一段公告、消息或提示做成通知横幅,用于视频角落叠加、产品发布预告或社媒图时触发。

say.text: 把这条公告做成 macOS 通知横幅,叠加到 1920×1080 视频右上角
say.note: 输出透明背景的单文件 HTML

say.text: 用暗色版,App 名写 Notes,标题是「更新已完成」,正文两行
say.note: 暗色磨砂版更推荐用于视频

say.text: 再堆叠两条通知在后面,加入从右侧滑入的入场动效
say.note: 后面两条会递缩并降低透明度

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude renders your announcement or message as a macOS Big Sur style notification banner: rounded frosted-glass background, app icon, title and body, output as a single HTML file — for a 1920×1080 video corner or a standalone 480×120 banner.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need an announcement, message or notice turned into a notification banner for a video corner overlay, a product launch teaser or a social image.

say_en.text: Turn this announcement into a macOS notification banner for the top-right of a 1920×1080 video
say_en.note: Outputs a single HTML file with transparent background

say_en.text: Use the dark version, app name Notes, title "Update complete", two-line body
say_en.note: Dark frosted version is recommended for video

say_en.text: Add two more stacked notifications behind it and a slide-in-from-right entrance
say_en.note: The extra two shrink and fade back
